INCREDIBLE's compounded profit growth over 10 years stands at an impressive 17% [E18], outpacing both the sector median of 21.4% and its own historical performance over the last five years, which was a robust 25% [E19]. This sustained profitability is a testament to INCREDIBLE's strong fundamentals and management team. INCREDIBLE has also demonstrated significant growth in capital expenditures (CWIP) with a 218.2% increase from the previous year [E40], indicating an active investment strategy aimed at future expansion and growth. This capex build-up phase suggests that INCREDIBLE is positioning itself for long-term success, which could lead to further profit growth. INCREDIBLE's recent profit growth has outpaced its stock price growth by 11% over the past year [E55], a clear indication of strong fundamentals driving market expectations. This divergence between earnings and share price movement points towards an undervalued stock that is starting to exceed investor expectations, making INCREDIBLE a compelling investment opportunity. While INCREDIBLE has experienced a sales decline of 11.6% over the past five years [E67], this negative metric does not outweigh its strong profit growth performance. The company's ability to maintain and even accelerate earnings growth despite declining sales is a positive sign, suggesting that INCREDIBLE may be more resilient than initially perceived. INCREDIBLE has been flagged as having delivered a 24.7% compound annual growth rate (CAGR) over the last five years [E58], which is notably higher than the sector median of 21.4%. This strong historical performance further reinforces INCREDIBLE's potential for future success and underscores its value proposition. In conclusion, INCREDIBLE Industries Ltd presents a compelling case as an underappreciated stock with robust financial metrics, including undervalued P/E and P/B ratios, impressive compounded profit growth over multiple time horizons, and strong fundamentals-led performance. These factors collectively support the notion that INCREDIBLE is trading at a discount to its intrinsic value, making it a worthwhile investment opportunity for discerning investors.
